DX 台指定在发射频率上方 1–10 kHz 收听，需把发射频率设到其收听频率。: The DX station specifies listening 1–10 kHz above its transmit frequency, so set your transmit frequency to where it listens.
DX 电台在 A 频率收听、B 频率发射，避免互相干扰，是追 DX 的基本功。: The DX station listens on frequency A and transmits on B to avoid mutual interference — a fundamental skill of DX chasing.
先守听，弄清 DX 台的收听频率（split 方向）再呼叫，不要在其发射频率上呼: Listen first to learn the DX station's listening frequency (the split direction) before calling; never call on its transmit frequency.
只报自己呼号，简洁重复 1–2 次即可，避免冗长。: Give only your callsign, repeated briefly once or twice; nothing long-winded.
An agreed segment of each band reserved for DX stations to transmit and local stations to listen (e.g. 14.190–14.200 on 20 m).
大量电台同时呼叫稀有台形成的堆积，需遵守礼仪、耐心守听。: The pile-up formed when many stations call a rare one at once; observe etiquette and listen patiently.
稀有台按分区/前缀点名时，耐心等待轮到你的分区。: When a rare station calls by zone or prefix, wait patiently for your zone.
被点到才发射，未点到勿反复呼叫，避免制造干扰。: Transmit only when called; if not called, do not call again and again, so as not to cause interference.
